messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in Biogeo
parts:
Thanks Nick,

Yes, it was a path issue. In case others have this problem:

For a Mac
In the pdf/plot portion of the sample, I changed 
scriptdir = np(system.file("~path", package="BioGeoBEARS"))
to
scriptdir = np(system.file("extdata/a_scripts", package="BioGeoBEARS"))
Basically just shortening the path let the machine figure out the folders location and call the cornercoords script.

Thanks again!
Jon
